---
title: "Collection Overview"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)

# Load data and remove blank rows
kimball <- read_csv(
  "data/kimball.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |> 
  filter(if_any(everything(), ~ !is.na(.x) & .x != ""))

# Create overview statistics
kimball_overview <- kimball |> 
  mutate(
    parsed_date = suppressWarnings(dmy(date))
  )

overview <- tibble(
  "Total Items" = nrow(kimball_overview),
  "Date Range" = paste(
    min(year(kimball_overview$parsed_date), na.rm = TRUE),
    "-",
    max(year(kimball_overview$parsed_date), na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  "Correspondents" = n_distinct(kimball_overview$author, na.rm = TRUE),
  "Letters" = sum(kimball_overview$type == "letter", na.rm = TRUE),
  "Telegrams" = sum(kimball_overview$type == "telegram", na.rm = TRUE),
  "Locations Represented" = n_distinct(kimball_overview$site, na.rm = TRUE)
)

kable(overview)
```
